turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here, Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son have a zero?
Sorry, I'm a bit frazzled, it's report card week.
I'm sure it is. Owen has a zero in your gradebook, and I'd like to know who decided that and when.
You're the first parent this month who's actually listened to me. Thank you. I mean it.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and when.
I really needed that today. Can we just be kind to each other in here?
Be kind to Owen. He found out about that zero on his phone, in front of his class. Tell me what you have, Hale, or take the zero off today.
